counter_correction: Includes tokenize(hello world!) known-ID assertion; original auditor unchanged.

tokenizer_selection.future_path: Transformers v4.41.2; explicitly BasicTokenizer(strip_accents=False, do_split_on_punc=False), fix_text=None; fail if a deployment selects ftfy or fast tokenizer without equivalence review
tokenizer_selection.implementation_executed: Original auditor extracts only tokenizer AST definitions; no external learned-model module imports
tokenizer_selection.regex_equivalence: For checked ASCII domain, Unicode L=A-Za-z, N=0-9. Stdlib re uses those exact replacements. BasicTokenizer/helpers/bpe/_tokenize/special-token builder are pinned source. Independent scanner and BPE agree on every measured string and 8 controls. Not proof for Unicode, embedded specials, ftfy or other releases.

assembly.existing_harness: harness.py:153-159 makes common object + exact A JSONL/B array; no operational GLIGEN string assembler exists
assembly.A: canonical(common) + one U+000A + exact persisted A.relations_and_locks; no trailing separator
assembly.B: canonical(common); B.relations_and_locks remains array on separate port
assembly.negative: empty string shared proposal, not a frozen operational setting
assembly.shared_phrases: Exact five common node labels, each separately encoded identically for visual association in A/B; no phrases synthesized from B
assembly.diagnostic_components: common.stable_cgc and common.approved_source_restrictions measured separately only for attribution; never appended twice
assembly.common_contains_relations: Existing protected_relationships/provenance are already present in common. Preserve them. This limits inference to incremental effect of representation/channel, not exclusive access to relation facts.

chosen_mechanism.split: Tokenize complete string once without truncation. Contiguous slices [75*k:75*(k+1)], not line/record truncation; preserve every token ID exactly once. Empty string produces one BOS/EOS block.
chosen_mechanism.specials_and_padding: Each chunk BOS=49406, up to75 content IDs, EOS=49407, right-pad EOS to77; mask valid BOS/content/EOS, zero padding. Local CLIP positions0..76 unchanged. Gather content positions1..n only; empty prompt uses its actual EOS hidden state as a defined sentinel.
chosen_mechanism.positions: Add learned chunk-index embedding (0..127) to each retained hidden state before resampling; CLIP local positional embeddings remain. Ordered chunk IDs prevent permutation invariance across chunks; no claim of learned order until tested.
chosen_mechanism.resampler: 4 blocks, d=768,8 heads,128 learned query slots; each block queries all masked input embeddings, latent self-attention, FF width3072, layer norms; dropout0 for evaluation. Same exact modules/weights in A, B, negative path.
chosen_mechanism.output_dtype: float32 reference; fp16 deployment only after preregistered repeat test
chosen_mechanism.output_mask: all128 slots valid; no source-token padding leaked into softmax
chosen_mechanism.encoder_mask: Explicit CLIP attention_mask for chunk pads; no change to max_position_embeddings. Causal encoder processing retained.
chosen_mechanism.overflow_policy: Reject >9600 content tokens, unsupported domain, reserved input tokens, fields or vocabulary before any learned forward. Do not truncate, summarize, skip records or fallback to B prompt. Non-D inputs not automatically admitted.
chosen_mechanism.shared_phrase_path: Same pinned CLIP, exact individual labels <=77; use pooled EOS output for five source association tokens. No phrase truncation. Proposed shared visual projector separate from resampler.

UNet_consumers.compatibility: UNet2DConditionModel passes [batch,L,768] and encoder_attention_mask; BasicTransformerBlock.attn2 -> Attention processors derives key length from encoder_hidden_states; L128 structurally supported.
Resampler output is NOT gligen objs. Shared source tokens and B relational tokens arrive through a new external relational port, projected to768 then fuser.linear to query_dim.
Checkpoint has no addition_embed_type/encoder_hid_dim branch configured; do not inject pooled text/time/image adapters. Preserve PNDM and UNet timestep embedding.

128-slot positive and negative outputs have same shape; concatenate batch negative/positive. Unconditional half receives shared source tokens and no B relation tokens; identical policy across branches.
